description: This file is a Next.js React component for the 'explore' page, handling role searches, filters, suggested roles, and UI rendering including sticky header and search functionality.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the backend API base URL for client-side fetches, reading environment variables.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Combines base URL and path into a full URL, handling slashes.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range string and converts USD to INR lakhs with configurable exchange rate.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Converts a backend role search result row into a UI Role object with defaults.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Maps a recommended role object into the UI role format.
